scope: route decision evidence consolidation only; no new generation algorithm; no default pipeline change

routes.name: MakeMeAHanzi median + style profile
routes.recommended_use: Use as the current default system backbone and robot dry-run/precheck route.
strengths: Supports execution trajectory, workspace mapping, resampling, CoppeliaSim pen-tip playback, robot target poses, AUBO i5 command dry-run, and IK feasibility dry-run
Suitable for demonstrating natural-language constraints and deterministic orchestration
limitations: Xingkai resembles kaishu centerline plus procedural connectors
Lishu resembles globally widened and flattened kaishu skeleton
Modifier connection, shape, and smoothness figures are controllable but not visually strong enough to claim mature style generation
routes.paper_role: Main system baseline and robot precheck backbone

routes.name: Median + font skeleton/mask adaptation
routes.recommended_use: Continue only as bounded diagnostic adaptation that preserves MakeMeAHanzi stroke order.
strengths: Preserves MakeMeAHanzi stroke order and stroke breaks
Works as a light morphology adaptation route for low-risk samples such as ren/kaishu
Can provide a bridge between stable median strokes and font-derived style references
limitations: Alpha-only projection improves distance but not strong style structure
Shan/lishu remains difficult: projection improves but aspect and lower-half structure improve only slightly
Structure and component variants hit shift caps
Increasing alpha or global pulling is not a good direction
routes.paper_role: Exploratory style adaptation evidence and limitation analysis

routes.name: Font skeleton derived path
routes.recommended_use: Use as manually screened small-sample style-basis evidence; do not connect to the default pipeline.
strengths: Strongest visible font-style signal in selected samples
Shows glyph structure that global scaling cannot express
Useful for style-basis diagnostics and future hybrid design
limitations: Branch points, endpoints, and disconnected components are risky for complex characters
Approaches the old image-skeleton route and can inherit its generalization problems

current_recommendation: Keep Route A as the stable baseline and robot precheck backbone; treat Route B as bounded style adaptation research; treat Route C as manually screened style-basis evidence. Next, design a hybrid route before adding more generation algorithms.

next_options.name: Hybrid route design spec
next_options.description: Write a design-only specification where A provides stroke order and execution chain, B provides bounded adaptation, and C provides font-outline style reference.

next_options.name: Small Route C expansion
next_options.description: Expand only simple kaishu/lishu samples under manual screening; do not handle xingkai or complex characters yet.

next_options.name: Paper minimum mainline
next_options.description: Use Route A as the system paper backbone and present B/C as limitation-driven exploratory evidence.

explicit_boundaries: Do not continue blind connector/taper tuning as the main route.
Do not connect font skeleton derived paths to the default pipeline now.
Do not claim high-quality real calligraphy style generation.
AUBO i5 work remains dry-run/precheck only, not real IK or physical robot writing.
